print.title: Order a printed book
print.subtitle: Printed and shipped by our print partner Peecho
print.pagesExplained: The first page becomes the front cover. A plain back cover in the cover's colour is added at the end.
print.blankAdded: A blank page goes in before the back cover, because a book needs an even number of pages.
print.tooFewPages: Hardcover books need at least {{min}} pages, and this one has {{count}}. Add pages for a hardcover, or pick another product at checkout.
print.marginTip: Keep text and faces about 1 cm away from the page edges – the very edge can be trimmed when the book is bound.
print.privacyBody: A print shop can only print what it can read. To order, Kaydo turns this book into an unencrypted PDF and gives Peecho a private link to it. Anyone who has that link can open the file. It is deleted automatically after {{days}} days.
print.keepOpen: Please keep this page open until it is done.
print.readyHeading: Your book is ready to order
print.readyBody: At Peecho's checkout you choose the product, enter the shipping address and pay. Peecho prints the book and sends it to you.
print.checkoutUnavailable: Peecho's checkout could not be loaded. If you use an ad or content blocker, allow peecho.com and try again.
print.failed: The print file could not be prepared. Please try again.
print.noProduct: Peecho has no product for a book of {{count}} pages in this size yet. Hardcover books need at least 24 pages – add pages, or ask whoever runs Kaydo to offer a product that fits.
